{{Quote|Escaped slaves... stole weapons from the Academy... fled into this tomb. They've reprogrammed... the mining droids.|Peyterra|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Peyterra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] studying in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Korriban Sith Academy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] to become a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. While performing a mission in one of the tombs in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] she came across a group of armed [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. She managed to fend them off, but sustained [[Death/Legends|fatal]] injuries in process and collapsed shortly after recording her final [[Holomessage/Legends|holo-message]].
